metadata.purpose: Bibliographic sources for the Italian Silver Atlas. Each opportunity-sizing assumption used in Benchmark and Opportunity Explorer cites at least one of these sources.

sources.publisher: MEA, Max Planck Institute for Social Law and Social Policy
sources.title: Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE), Wave 9, release 9.0.0
sources.informs: All segmentation variables, profile centroids, behavioural and economic indicators.

sources.title: Demographic data: resident population by age, 2024
Report Osservatorio GIMBE 2.2025: La spesa sanitaria privata in Italia nel 2023
sources.informs: Total Italian out-of-pocket health spending (€40.6B 2023); per-capita OOP €730/year; intermediated insurance €5.2B; share of cure assistance (incl dental) at 44.6%.

sources.title: Sanità integrativa in Italia, raccolta premi 2024
sources.informs: Italian supplementary health insurance market: €6.8B in 2024, +8.4% YoY, 25%+ population coverage. Average family premium €1,300-2,000/year.

sources.title: Analisi congiunturale della professione odontoiatrica 2024 (riferito al 2023)
sources.informs: Italian dental private spending €8.5B in 2023; ~30% of total OOP healthcare; price growth +2.5% YoY.

sources.publisher: Aggregator: Poste Assicura, UniSalute, Groupama, Intesa Sanpaolo, BPER (XME, dr-Smile, Sorriso products)
sources.title: Italian individual private dental insurance product pages, 2024-2025
sources.informs: Senior individual dental insurance premiums: €150-1,000/year; monthly typical €20-40; basic prevention from €100/year; comprehensive €400-800/year.

sources.publisher: Censis / business reviewers (BusinessOnLine, Salute Privata, Cup Solidale)
sources.title: Tariffe medie visite specialistiche private 2024
sources.informs: Private specialist visit fees in Italy: cardiology €100-200, ophthalmology €80-150, orthopaedics €100-200; tests add €50-150.

sources.publisher: Aggregators: Quotalo, Sespera, Pensionati CISL Lombardia, Trend-online
sources.title: Costi medi RSA e cohousing senior in Italia 2024-2026
sources.informs: RSA monthly cost average €1,700; range €1,300-2,500; cohousing €1,800-3,000; luxury senior living €2,000-3,000+.

sources.title: Rapporto OsMed 2024: L'uso dei farmaci in Italia
sources.informs: Senior pharmacy spending €570/year per over-65 user; private pharma spending €7B in 2024 of which €3.4B OTC; 97.4% of seniors had at least one prescription; 68% polypharmacy.

sources.title: Rapporto sul Private Banking in Italia 2024
sources.informs: Italian private banking AUM €1,300B (2024) → €1,398B (2025E); fee shift from commission-only (84.4% → 80.6%) to fee-only and fee-over models.

sources.publisher: BG SAXO, Studio Marco Franco, Consulenza Vincente
sources.title: Commissioni gestione patrimoniale Italia 2024
sources.informs: Italian wealth management fees: 1.5-3% AUM/year (private banking high tier 2-4%); average investor 2-3.5% all-in including hidden fees; fee-only / robo 0.5-1.2%.

sources.title: La ricchezza dei settori istituzionali in Italia, 2024
sources.informs: Italian household total net wealth €11,732B (2024), +2.8% nominal YoY but -5.0% real vs 2021.

sources.title: Digital economy and society statistics: individuals using the internet, 2018-2024
sources.informs: Italy 65-74 internet use: 60.4% (2023) → 65.6% (2024), +5.2pp YoY post-pandemic; Sweden 65-74: ~87% in recent years; gap to Sweden ~22pp in 2024.

sources.title: Cittadini e ICT — Anno 2024
sources.informs: Italian ICT use trend among 65-74 cohort, 2018-2024.
